arxiv-1903-05318.title: C λ \displaystyle C_{\lambda} - Extended oscillator algebra and d \displaystyle d -orthogonal polynomials
arxiv-1903-05318.creator: Fethi Bouzeffour ∗,⋄ , Wissem Jedidi §,⋄
arxiv-1903-05318.description: Abstract Abstract: In this paper we first construct an analytic realization of the \displaystyle C_{\lambda} -extended oscillator algebra with the help of difference-differential operators. Secondly, we study families of \displaystyle d -orthogonal polynomials which are extensions of the Hermite and Laguerre polynomials.

arxiv-1907-10925.title: On Uniform Equivalence of Epistemic Logic Programs DOI: S1471068401001193
arxiv-1907-10925.creator: WOLFGANG FABER 1, MICHAEL MORAK 1, and STEFAN WOLTRAN 2 1 University of Klagenfurt, Austria 2 TU Wien, Vienna, Austria
arxiv-1907-10925.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by WOLFGANG FABER 1, MICHAEL MORAK 1, and STEFAN WOLTRAN 2 1 University of Klagenfurt, Austria 2 TU Wien, Vienna, Austria. Epistemic Logic Programs (ELPs) extend Answer Set Programming (ASP) with epistemic negation and have received renewed interest in recent years. This led to the development of new research and efficient solving systems for ELPs.

arxiv-2106-00807.title: Finite distributive nearlattices
arxiv-2106-00807.creator: Luciano J. González, Ismael Calomino
arxiv-2106-00807.description: Abstract . Our main goal is to develop a representation for finite distributive nearlattices through certain ordered structures. This representation generalizes the well-known representation given by Birkhoff for finite distributive lattices through finite posets. We also study finite distributive nearlattices through the concepts of dual atoms, boolean elements, complemented elements and irreducible elements.

arxiv-2305-05359.creator: Barış Göktepe 1 , Cornelius Hellge 1 , Tatiana Rykova 1 , Thomas Schierl 1 and Slawomir Stanczak 1 2
arxiv-2305-05359.description: Abstract We provide a mathematical framework to analyze the limits of Hybrid Automatic Repeat reQuest (HARQ) and derive analytical expressions for the most powerful test for estimating the decodability under maximum-likelihood decoding and t t -error decoding. Furthermore, we numerically approximate the most powerful test for sum-product decoding.

arxiv-2306-17104.title: Deep Ensemble for Rotorcraft Attitude Prediction
arxiv-2306-17104.creator: Hikmat Khan, Nidhal C. Bouaynaya, Ghulam Rasool, Tyler Travis, Lacey Thompson, Charles C. Johnson
arxiv-2306-17104.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Hikmat Khan, Nidhal C. Bouaynaya, Ghulam Rasool, Tyler Travis, Lacey Thompson, Charles C. Johnson. Historically, the rotorcraft community has experienced a higher fatal accident rate than other aviation segments, including commercial and general aviation. To date, traditional methods applied to reduce incident rates have not proven hugely successful for the rotorcraft community. Recent advancements in artificial intelligence (AI) and the application of these technologies in different areas of our lives are both intriguing and encouraging.

arxiv-2311-17412.title: Electroweak Strings in the Standard Model
arxiv-2311-17412.creator: Li-Ping Zou, Pengming Zhang, Y. M. Cho
arxiv-2311-17412.description: Abstract We argue that the existence of the electroweak monopole predicts the existence of the electroweak string in the standard model made of monopole-antimonopole pair separated infinitely apart, which carry the quantized magnetic flux 4 ​ π ​ n / e 4\pi n/e . We show how to construct such quantized magnetic flux string solution.

arxiv-2312-17679.title: Data Augmentation for Supervised Graph Outlier Detection via Latent Diffusion Models
arxiv-2312-17679.creator: Kay Liu, Hengrui Zhang, Ziqing Hu, Fangxin Wang, Philip S. Yu
arxiv-2312-17679.description: Abstract A fundamental challenge confronting supervised graph outlier detection algorithms is the prevalent problem of class imbalance , where the scarcity of outlier instances compared to normal instances often results in suboptimal performance. Recently, generative models, especially diffusion models, have demonstrated their efficacy in synthesizing high-fidelity images.

pmc-10655376.title: Association between vaginal microbiome alteration and povidone iodine use during delivery
pmc-10655376.creator: Hongping Li, Hongqin Zhang, Linhua Geng, Hongli Huang, Chuan Nie, Yuanfang Zhu
pmc-10655376.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundThe vaginal microbiome is a dynamic community of microorganisms in the vagina. Its alteration may be influenced by multiple factors, including gestational status, menstrual cycle, sexual intercourse, hormone levels, hormonal contraceptives, and vaginal drug administration. Povidone iodine has been used before delivery to reduce infection that may be caused by the ascendance of pathogenic and opportunistic bacteria from the vagina to the uterus.

pmc-11690600.title: DEEP PROTEOMIC PROFILING OF ACCELERATED KIDNEY AGING AND SENESCENCE BURDEN IN MACACA MULATTA
pmc-11690600.creator: Christina King, Jordan Burton, George Schaaf, Stephen Kritchevsky, J Cline, Jamie Justice, Ellen Quillen, Birgit Schilling
pmc-11690600.description: Whole-body ionizing radiation (IR) is a stressor that causes damage to DNA, lipids, and proteins, and in the latent-phase, may lead to oxidative stress, inflammation, and cellular senescence. Slowly-reproducing tissues, including kidney, are more likely to react to DNA damaging stressors, which may exacerbate aging processes.

pmc-12656519.title: First Human Biomonitoring Evidence of Strobilurin Fungicide Exposure in South China: Impact on Oxidative Stress and Liver Damage
pmc-12656519.creator: Bo Zhang, Shuai Feng, Yanxia Gao, Wenxi Xie, Yiyu Chen, Shiming Song
pmc-12656519.description: Background: Strobilurin fungicides (SFs) are widely detected in the environment, but data on their occurrence in humans and potential health effects are scarce. Objective: This study aimed to characterize the exposure to SFs in a human population from South China and to investigate their potential association with biomarkers of oxidative stress and liver damage.

pmc-13086885.title: Urease-null soybean (eu3-a) under salt and copper stress: nitrogen metabolism, antioxidant defense, and arginine pathway genes
pmc-13086885.creator: Sarah Caroline R de Souza, Neidiquele M Silveira, Vanessa R Tofanello, Joe Carmine Polacco, Paulo Mazzafera
pmc-13086885.description: Main conclusion The eu3-a mutant exhibited greater tolerance to salt stress but increased sensitivity to copper stress, with distinct impacts on nitrogen metabolism, photosynthesis, and antioxidant responses. AbstractThe eu3-a soybean mutant is urease-null, lacking all urease activity responsible for catalyzing the hydrolysis of urea into ammonia and carbon dioxide.

pmc-13522747.title: Beyond the alarm: unveiling the multifaceted role of IL-33 in kidney disease
pmc-13522747.creator: Mei Yang, Suning Miao, Mingli Yu, Xiaoqing Fu, Xiaosong Qin
pmc-13522747.description: Interleukin-33 (IL-33) has long been categorized as a prototypical alarmin released upon cellular injury to initiate Th2-skewed immune responses. However, accumulating evidence from diverse kidney disease models and patient cohorts has unveiled a far more complex and contextually governed functionality.

pmc-13651076.title: Eating behavior traits across thyroid function groups in Saudi adults: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13651076.creator: Hayat Alzahrani, Sahar G. Alshammari, Soaad Alsulami, Sahar Afeef, Nehal S. Alsharif, Sarah Althubeati, Sarah M. Arafsha, Amal Aloud
pmc-13651076.description: BackgroundThyroid dysfunction is known to impact metabolic rate and body weight, yet its relationship with eating behavior remains underexplored in Saudi adults. This study explores the differences in appetitive traits across self-reported thyroid status groups using the validated Arabic version of the Adult Eating Behavior Questionnaire (AEBQ-Ar).
